source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 台风白海豚已达17级 可能直奔中国
topics.official_english: Typhoon Dolphin has reached wind level 17 and may head straight for China
topics.why_hot: A powerful typhoon is being closely tracked because of its potential impact on China, triggering public concern about safety and preparation.
topics.share_angle: Explain how typhoon strength is measured in China and what people in coastal provinces should watch for.

topics.chinese_topic: 下半年经济工作发力方向划重点
topics.official_english: Key priorities for China's economic work in the second half of the year
topics.why_hot: The policy tone for the second half of the year shapes expectations for growth, jobs, and consumption, so the topic drew wide discussion.
topics.share_angle: Sort through the announced priorities and explain what they signal for households and businesses.

topics.chinese_topic: 民宿老板快被这个暑期熬垮了
topics.official_english: Homestay owners say this summer season is wearing them down
topics.why_hot: During the summer travel peak, many small homestay operators are describing intense pressure, prompting discussion about tourism and small businesses.
topics.share_angle: Use their experience as a window into the economics of running a small hospitality business in China.

topics.chinese_topic: 取消午休4点下班你同意吗
topics.official_english: Would you support canceling the lunch break and leaving at 4 p.m.?
topics.why_hot: The idea of trading a lunch break for an earlier finish touched off debate about productivity, rest, and workplace culture in China.
topics.share_angle: Use the proposal as a gateway to compare Chinese work schedules with flexible-hour practices elsewhere.

topics.chinese_topic: 国家电网原董事长辛保安被查
topics.official_english: Former State Grid Chairman Xin Bao'an placed under investigation
topics.why_hot: News of an investigation into a former top executive of State Grid, a major state-owned utility, drew attention to energy-sector governance.
topics.share_angle: Explain the significance of State Grid and how such official investigations are typically announced.

topics.chinese_topic: 今后借钱必须明码标价
topics.official_english: From now on, borrowing money must be clearly priced
topics.why_hot: The topic signals possible new rules on transparent loan pricing, which directly affects consumers and the financial sector.
topics.share_angle: Explain what 'clear pricing' for lending means and how it could change the way loans are advertised.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国最高薪本科专业易主
topics.official_english: China's highest-paid undergraduate major has a new leader
topics.why_hot: New salary data for college majors draws attention from students and parents deciding on education and career paths.
topics.share_angle: Explore what the changing salary ranking says about job-market demand and how students choose majors.

topics.chinese_topic: 吴宜泽无缘斯诺克上海大师赛决赛
topics.official_english: Wu Yize misses out on the final of the Shanghai Masters snooker tournament
topics.why_hot: A young Chinese player's near-miss at a home tournament generated encouragement and disappointment among sports fans.
topics.share_angle: Recap Wu Yize's run in the tournament and look at China's growing presence in international snooker.
